description: Desktop port of the Legado (阅读 3.0) reader, with a local library and Legado book-source/RSS/backup interop

suggest.extras/webview2: Reader is a Tauri app and needs the WebView2 Runtime (preinstalled on current Windows 10/11)

notes: This is hadc188's community desktop port of the Legado reader, not the Android Legado app or the hectorqin/reader web server.
The package is called legado-reader because a plain 'reader' manifest already exists in other buckets for a different program.

Update with 'scoop update legado-reader'. The in-app update button replaces Reader.exe inside the Scoop version directory and leaves Scoop's recorded version stale; turning off 'Auto check updates' (自动检查更新) in Settings avoids the prompt.
Library data lives in persist\legado-reader\data. A copy installed by the vendor setup or winget keeps its data next to its own Reader.exe; copy that data folder here before the first launch.
